objective: Without changing any source file: build an inventory of the repository's packages. For every directory directly under apps/ or packages/ that has a package.json, plus mobile/, report its directory, its package name, its scripts.test command (null when there is none) and whether it is dependency-free (declares no dependencies and no devDependencies). Write ANSWER.json as {"packages": [{"dir": "apps/web", "name": "...", "test": "..." | null, "dependencyFree": true | false}, ...]} sorted by dir.
